source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: findServer normalizes optional lookup filters and compares a candidate only when the corresponding filter is truthy. Optional chaining makes absent username, serverURI.host or type compare as missing rather than throwing. A supplied filter rejects that candidate; an absent filter leaves that property unchecked. This does not validate every server or establish its protocol capability.
title: Outgoing-server lookup tests optional metadata only for supplied filters
